We Are

Sapiens International Corporation N.V. is a global leader of AI-centric, SaaS-based insurance software, delivering hyper-relevant experiences that are efficient, compliant, and innovative. With agile intelligence, Sapiens' solutions turn real-time data and human insight into precise action at every moment, across every risk.

The Sapiens platform includes agentic workflows accelerating every capability across policy, underwriting, claims, reinsurance, decisioning, and finance and compliance.

With more than 600 insurers in over 30 countries running on Sapiens, our deep industry expertise is the foundation of our long-term relationships, from initial implementation through to modernization and market transformation.

Sapiens is headquartered in London, serving customers in property and casualty, life, reinsurance, specialty, and workers’ compensation from offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific.

Why You Will Love Being Part of Sapiens

Be part of the insurance digitization revolution. Our people are recognized as experts all over the world. Become an expert yourself in a fast-growing company, with various development and personal growth paths.

Bring your unique color to Sapiens. We have a deep culture of listening to our people. We always encourage them to speak up and make an impact.

Sapiens’ consistent growth generates and enables an abundance of opportunities for our employees’ professional and personal growth.

Caring is an important part of Sapiens' culture. We see all our employees for who they are. We care for and appreciate each other. As a community we love working together, and we support each other from every location and time zone. 

Work in a global team, get to see the world, and the beauty of inclusion. Enjoy the international vibe of working in an inclusive global team. Meet and work with interesting people from around the world. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Diversity is a priority for us. Women comprise 35% of our team, 33% in tech roles, and an impressive 38% of our executive management.
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment and have various programs to support and celebrate all aspects of diversity within our workforce, ensuring we maintain and increase representation across the board.

Career Development

We are passionate about nurturing both professional and personal growth. Our dynamic learning and development programs empower our team to excel.
From insurance eLearning and classroom courses for new joiners to exciting initiatives like Sapiens University, global learning weeks, interactive learning games, and a digital chatbot, we ensure our employees have the tools they need to thrive.

Employee Wellness

We prioritize the holistic well-being of our employees, offering various health and wellness services across our offices. These include medical checks, well-being webinars, flu vaccines, psychological counseling, mindfulness sessions, and a 24/7 mental health hotline. We regularly review and update these programs to best serve our team.

Discover Life at Sapiens

Curious about what it’s like to work at Sapiens? Here’s where you can discover the people, culture, and everyday experiences that shape our global community. From team spirit to local traditions, explore how life at Sapiens comes to life around the world.

With teams in 30+ countries, there’s always a way to connect - visit our Sapiens Global Community page to learn more.
